settings.title: Measure at the end of the day
settings.text: Fingers are often slightly larger later in the day. Avoid measuring when hands are cold.

settings.title: Consider band width
settings.text: Wider bands can feel firmer and may need a half size up for comfort.

settings.title: If between sizes, choose larger
settings.text: A ring should slide over the knuckle with gentle resistance and sit comfortably once in place.

settings.heading: Find a comfortable, confident fit
settings.subheading: A refined fit considers temperature, timing, band width, knuckle shape, and how the ring will be worn every day.
settings.cta_text: Joyari can guide sizing before production and note fit preferences with your custom request.
